  \operatorname{Hilb}_{Q}(z)

## Strategy
Extracted the degreewise Smith quotient ranks and torsion lists from the accepted finite computation. Since
\[
\binom52_z=1+z+2z^2+2z^3+2z^4+z^5+z^6,
\]
the requested Hilbert-series target is established for this computed case.

## Gaps
This is a finite computed result for the artifact’s input \([333,5^5]\) in degrees \(9,\ldots,25\); it is not a universal claim.
